metadata.reference: Ibën Sunnij fq. 138, nr. 278 “Vabil es-Sajjib” të Ibën Kajjimit fq. 304, me recensimin e Beshir Muhamed Nuajm.

translations.english: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (May Allah bless you all.) AAaishah would then say: (and may Allah bless them.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)
